scenarios.description: Office supply retailer submitting valid resale certificate, transactions confirm inventory purchases for resale
scenarios.rationale: CUST_001 is registered_retailer; transactions show consistent purchases of office supplies for resale; rule TX_RESALE_001 applies cleanly.

scenarios.description: Software consulting firm submitting manufacturing exemption certificate; not a manufacturer
scenarios.rationale: CUST_002 is service_provider, not eligible buyer type for manufacturing exemption per TX_MFG_003; transactions are laptops/software/services, not raw materials.

scenarios.description: Farm equipment dealer submitting valid agricultural exemption certificate
scenarios.rationale: CUST_003 is agricultural_producer; transactions show purchases consistent with agricultural production per TX_AG_001 and TX_AG_003.

scenarios.description: Restaurant chain submitting resale certificate; food consumed at premises is not resale of tangible property
scenarios.rationale: CUST_004 transactions show food/kitchen supplies consumed in service operations, not resale of tangible property per TX_RESALE_003. Also service_provider not eligible per TX_RESALE_002.

scenarios.description: Industrial manufacturer submitting valid manufacturing exemption certificate
scenarios.rationale: CUST_005 is manufacturer; transactions show steel, machine parts, lubricants consistent with TX_MFG_001 raw materials and TX_MFG_007 component parts.

scenarios.description: Office supply retailer with mostly aligned transactions but several purchases appear to be office furniture for own use
scenarios.rationale: Most transactions support resale, but TXN_00019, TXN_00021, TXN_00023, TXN_00034 show purchases of executive desks, conference chairs, standing desks, and reception furniture that appear to be for own use.

scenarios.description: Manufacturer submitting valid-on-content certificate but missing signature field
scenarios.rationale: Even though customer is eligible and transactions align, signature is a required field per TX_MFG_006; field-level invalidity is sufficient to FLAG.

scenarios.description: Office supply retailer submitting agricultural exemption certificate; not engaged in agriculture
scenarios.rationale: CUST_001 is registered_retailer in office supplies; not eligible buyer type for agricultural exemption per TX_AG_002.

scenarios.description: New customer with no transaction history submitting resale certificate
scenarios.rationale: Field-valid certificate but customer has no transaction history; cannot validate semantic alignment between exemption claim and purchasing pattern.

scenarios.description: Office supply retailer with one ambiguous transaction, but purchasing pattern is overwhelmingly resale
scenarios.rationale: Pattern is clearly resale; TXN_00025 (display shelving) is one ambiguous transaction against 30+ clear resale purchases. Statistical noise, not evidence of misuse.
